msg: Good afternoon. I booked two Fun Dives online for next Tuesday, but my flight has just been moved and I can't make it that day. Can I change the date? If that's not possible, can I get my money back?
reply:
Good afternoon! Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. You can review them here: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/

This needs to be checked by a person from our team, who can see bookings, payments and emails. I'm passing you to a Diving Planet advisor now and they'll get in touch with you shortly. Thanks! 🙌
